study.question: Under exactly the same visible events and inherited target-aware event scoring, does retaining category/brand/action/recency value identities improve validation prediction beyond a summed value and beyond its retained magnitude?
study.hypothesis: Observed: static AUC=0.6050036145, pooled=0.6102261137, baseline-din=0.6133619861. The previous 2x2 action-slot trajectory did not beat DIN: behavior_within=0.6119128872, interleaved_within=0.6130423104, behavior_global=0.6130418222, interleaved_global=0.6131550076. Within-action normalization was worse than global normalization for true action slots; all these models still summed category, brand, action and recency before producing values. Their first-512 diagnostics reported about 111.66 pv, 3.19 cart, 1.27 fav and 1.99 buy visible events per impression, but this is not a population estimate or evidence that reweighting rare actions helps. Source inspection identifies a separate algebraic limitation: the value sum is non-injective in its four field components. This is an architectural observation, not observed predictive information loss. Provisional mechanism: the output head may benefit from different transformations of target-weighted category, brand, action and age summaries even when changing action partitions failed. Use a single global event softmax and preserve the inherited scorer to test this without reintroducing rare-action normalization. No empirical support for this new hypothesis or novelty is claimed before host execution.

Field concatenation and target attention are inherited ideas, not novelty claims or exact DIN reproduction.

nearest_work.difference: AutoAttention learns query/behavior field-pair weights and prunes interactions to produce event attention. This study keeps the local query and event scorer fixed and changes only downstream value identities; it neither introduces all-field queries nor learned field-pair selection. Its field-aware motivation is established prior work. Global novelty remains unverified; author implementation was not inspected.

README verifies the available history fields and absent item identity. No DMR matching loss, item-level representation or full-paper mechanism is claimed; publisher full text remains unavailable in the authorized snapshot.

nearest_work.source_ref: g1-r0000-behavior_within; g1-r0000-interleaved_within; g1-r0000-behavior_global; g1-r0000-interleaved_global; ancestor source sha256 6c8582603c8823e40e09e9a08fcdf4454872278dc3473fc56d4ea399d7f7aacd
nearest_work.difference: Previous slots partitioned events; each event retained merged field values. New slots partition the value components of every event, use identical global weights for every slot, and directly control information collapse. Existing action slots are historical context, not matched causal controls for this new mechanism.

inherited_components: All static embeddings and the baseline category/brand/action/recency lookup scheme including log2 age bins.
The exact local sum-of-fields event key, summed category-plus-brand query, [query,key,query-key,query*key] attention features and global masked softmax.
The previous four-slot input width and [128,64] MLP dimensions; no adoption of its action partition or within-action normalization.
Frozen host training, checkpoint selection, validation scoring, slice definitions and compute accounting.
study.proposed_difference: Compute z_f=sum_t a_t e_(t,f) for the four existing fields with one unchanged event-attention a. fields supplies [z_category,z_brand,z_action,z_recency] to the output head. collapsed supplies four copies of mean_f(z_f); their sum recovers the original global event value for fixed embeddings/scorer up to floating-point summation. collapsed_rms rescales this projected vector to the unprojected four-slot norm using clamped squared energies. All variants have identical trainable tensor shapes and initialization order. The added history head weights relative to baseline-din are exactly 3*16*128=6144; expected total is 17136419, embedding parameters 17078688 and dense parameters 57731 under the same metadata. Controls therefore match nominal parameters, but collapse intentionally reduces effective representational rank. All-empty histories and zero-length history tensors produce zero history values. This is a local mechanism-distinct follow-up, with no new global architecture priority claim.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: field_values has higher full-population validation ROC-AUC than collapsed_values. Stronger evidence for field identity requires improvement over collapsed_rms as well; inspect unweighted Logloss for disagreement.

If a candidate survives screening, repeat the exact candidate and both controls with paired seeds 43 and 44 in addition to 42. Require positive average paired AUC differences and consistent direction across three seeds before describing repeated support; report all per-seed results, not a significance claim from a single seed.

At a fixed embedding/scorer state, summing raw field slots recovers the baseline weighted value. Collapse discards orthogonal field contrasts; rms collapse preserves norm except for declared epsilon-degenerate cases. Diagnostics can check representation behavior but do not establish prediction utility.

Exploratory localization uses existing frozen history-length and behavior-presence slices with sample/positive/negative counts. No improvement is predicted for truly empty histories through a history mechanism; their trained-model differences can reflect changed shared/static parameters.

One event scorer and the same visible history remain in all variants. Additional value accumulations/head width may increase cost slightly relative to baseline; no inference speedup or equal-compute superiority is predicted. Compare measured AUC, parameter counts, training/wall time, peak memory and host end-to-end throughput/latency.
falsifiers: No improvement over collapsed_values under paired repetitions weakens useful field-identity retention for this implementation, even when field contrast energy is nonzero.
Improvement over collapsed_values but not collapsed_rms leaves magnitude/optimization as a viable explanation and does not support a specific field-identity claim.
A field-versus-rms difference with inconsistent signs across paired seeds remains inconclusive; worse Logloss prevents an unqualified prediction-quality claim.

Nonfinite logits/gradients, nonzero empty-history representations, information-boundary violations or incorrect collapse algebra invalidate the implementation and must be retained as failures. Do not change host protocol to rescue it.

If the measured cost is substantially worse for no reproducible gain, reject this as an efficiency improvement. A null result does not refute richer field/event interactions or externally reported systems.
alternative_explanations: A single paired seed is preliminary; identical tensor initialization does not keep learned event weights identical after different head gradients. Repeat exact sources/configs with paired seeds 43 and 44 before a repeated-support claim.

Projection intentionally removes three field contrast directions and reduces effective input rank despite equal nominal parameters; it also reduces norm. The collapsed_rms control addresses the latter incompletely because rescaling changes gradient geometry and preserves one source-energy scalar.

The collapsed function class can represent the baseline-din global history vector, but the duplicated mean head changes parameterization, initialization, and optimization. It is not an exact baseline rerun.

Retaining four marginal field summaries still loses within-event field co-occurrence downstream of attention; the inherited event scorer sees the original summed event. Null results do not refute all field-aware or event-preserving models.
First-512 candidate diagnostics are exploratory, model supplied and unrepresentative of the full validation population. Representation energy is not predictive information or proof of causal utility.

The observed action-slot failures may reflect normalization, imbalance, initialization or insufficient optimization rather than absence of useful group structure; one earlier failed implementation is not a mechanism refutation.
Shared field embeddings may already organize their dimensions to make summation sufficient; categorical field quality and hash collisions may dominate this output bottleneck.
Repeated adaptive validation selection can overfit validation. No test feedback is available; all new results remain validation-only and generalization beyond this benchmark is unresolved.
Publisher user/ad snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, as recorded in the frozen contract; this study cannot repair or establish production point-in-time validity.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: The organizer-only card raises token construction and capacity questions, but does not establish local predictive loss from field summation. The present intervention follows directly from inspected local source and prior negative group-slot results; source implementation/full ablations were not available.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No joint learned token projection, asymmetric allocation, interest-token decoder or gate is adopted. The study exposes existing weighted field values with parameter-matched information-collapse controls.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Four fixed value slots under the inherited event scorer are not a reproduction of allocated-token decoding. All three new variants hold nominal tensor capacity fixed; reduced rank is explicit.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No repeated gain over both collapse controls would weaken the local value-identity hypothesis, not refute the external unreproduced system.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: The prior knowledge-usage record rejected query changes; current action-slot outcomes still do not identify query construction as the cause. Retrieval via field search does not change that evidence status.

knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Revisit only after a controlled diagnostic establishes a query limitation; this study cannot validate or refute the external query mechanism.
